text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused primarily on soil erosion assessment and prediction in the Bharathapuzha River Basin, India, including impacts on reservoir storage capacity. Land use–land cover (LULC) future prediction is incorporated as an input step rather than the primary focus. The study is at a river basin scale (regional/local), not national-scale spatial implementation. It does not meet the core inclusion criteria requiring explicit national-scale implementation and primary focus on LULC prediction with multiple future scenarios and quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC projections. Instead, LULC projections are used as one of the inputs to the soil erosion model. Furthermore, the scale is regional (river basin), and the main focus is environmental modeling of erosion and sedimentation rather than LULC prediction itself.)
